seo.title: SUP board advisor — which board suits you? | Suptime
seo.description: Answer a few questions (weight, experience, water type, goal) and get a personalized SUP board recommendation with prices and reviews.

wizard.title: Board advisor
wizard.lead: Five quick questions — and we'll show you which board fits you.

passenger.q: Will you take a passenger along?
passenger.hint: With an adult companion your COMBINED weight matters — we estimate about 70 kg. If your companion is much heavier, add the difference to your own weight.

water.q: Where will you paddle most often?

use.q: What will you mainly use it for?

kezdo-100-kg-felett.title: SUP for beginners over 100 kg
kezdo-100-kg-felett.seoTitle: SUP for beginners over 100 kg — which board can carry you? | Suptime
kezdo-100-kg-felett.seoDescription: A beginner over 100 kg? See what volume, length and load rating you need, and which boards in our catalogue fit.
kezdo-100-kg-felett.lead: If you start above 100 kg, the question is not which board looks nice but which one carries your weight safely. We show what the Board Advisor calculates for a 105 kg beginner.
tips: Body weight determines the board's volume (buoyancy), height determines its length — more weight needs more volume.
The load rating is a safety limit: the board must carry your weight with comfortable margin, so do not compromise on it.
As a beginner, a wide, stable board is the more confident choice.

csaladi.title: Family SUP advisor
csaladi.seoTitle: Family SUP advisor — a board for paddling with a child | Suptime
csaladi.seoDescription: Paddling with a child? See what load rating and volume the two of you need, and which boards in our catalogue fit.
csaladi.lead: With a passenger the load is your weight plus the passenger's estimated weight. The example is an 80 kg parent taking a child out on sheltered water.
tips: With a passenger the relevant load is your weight plus the passenger's estimated weight — the Board Advisor calculates with that. If the passenger is much heavier, add it to your own weight.
The load rating is a safety limit: do not compromise on it.
Start on sheltered water and choose a wide, stable board.

folyami.title: River SUP advisor
folyami.seoTitle: River SUP advisor — board and safety for flowing water | Suptime
folyami.seoDescription: Paddling on a river? See which board suits you, and what to know about leashes and life jackets in flowing water.
folyami.lead: Rivers follow different rules than still water. The example is an 80 kg intermediate paddler; the safety essentials are highlighted below.
tips: Body weight determines the board's volume (buoyancy), height determines its length.
The load rating is a safety limit: do not compromise on it.
On a river the type of leash and a life jacket need separate attention — see below.
